services.name: Charter a Fishing Trip
services.desc: Nothing beats the freedom of being on the water for a day of fishing, fun and relaxation. Spot n' Tails Fishing Charters in Corpus Christi wants you to make the most of your fishing charter by providing you with the guidance and expertise that you need to have a fun, successful day out. When you fish with Captain Larry, you benefit from his passion for fishing and more than 30 years of fishing experience. Whether you're a seasoned angler or just want to try fishing for the first time, Captain Larry has the perfect Corpus Christi fishing charter for you.
